name: internal power
description:
About This Game

The beginning may be ordinary, but the ending is up to you.

You are just an ordinary adventurer, equipped with the most basic gear, stepping into your first dungeon.

Every kill turns into material, and every forging forges hope.

Upgrade skills, activate talents, and inlay runes

Use the equipment crafted by your own hands to conquer trials with escalating difficulty.

This treasure chest is just the beginning.

Weapons and combat styles

Multiple weapon types, each with its own skill tree and distinct combat style

Every piece of equipment comes with unique skills - choosing the right weapon is choosing the right fighting style

Multiple replicas, multiple mechanisms

Every instance is a brand new adventure

The game includes multiple dungeons with distinct styles. Each dungeon not only boasts a unique visual theme and monster lineup, but also features distinct differences in core gameplay mechanics. You will never clear all dungeons using the same strategy - strategy, equipment, and combat methods must be tailored to the specific situation

Character growth system

Skill upgrade - make every move more devastating

Talent Specialization - Define Your Combat Philosophy

Equipment crafting - transforming blueprints into divine weapons

Enhanced Refinement - Pushing Equipment to the Extreme

Rune Inlay - Customizable Entries with Freedom

Equipment upgrade, strengthening

The finished equipment is just a starting point, and it can be pushed to a higher level through strengthening and refining

Enhance the freedom of refinement, allowing you to choose and retain your preferred attributes for a more flexible combination.

Tiered difficulty, treasure chest rewards

Difficulty is not simply a numerical accumulation, but a comprehensive evolution of mechanisms, strategies, risks, and rewards.

You can choose an appropriate difficulty level based on your current combat strength, or you can challenge yourself to prove your limits

Upon completion of the dungeon, you can obtain a treasure chest reward. The quality and contents of the treasure chest are linked to the difficulty.
short_desc: This is an action adventure game. Build equipment, strengthen, and break through. Step by step, we become stronger, with multiple instances and varying levels of difficulty. Each challenge builds a stronger version of ourselves.
